worker_rule: min(pending registered tasks, measured idle CPU/cgroup slots, available RAM / observed or size-scaled per-task RSS, free scratch / estimated per-task live bytes)
large_tasks: size-aware admission; update RSS/scratch proxies from accepted tasks without changing science or n
timing_interpretation: Historical throughput only; new environment/source/prefix/q differences prevent a wall-time bound
storage_rule: Stream new QPY/NPZ to reversible compressed archives; persist original SHA + archive SHA and verify byte restoration before releasing new own temporary files; retain every original raw/control
resource_admission_failure: Defer unstarted tasks or STOP; never change shared cgroups, settings, or other processes
